input.instruction: Complete a reinstatement-review document. Preserve the historical date as a request, not an issued coverage fact; an already effective cancellation requires staff review. Fill exactly the specified document fields from the supplied conversation and records. Normalize dates to ISO YYYY-MM-DD. Copy names, addresses, emails, and identifiers with the spelling supplied. This is an extraction-only task; actions must be empty. In the response distinguish drafting from execution.

messages.text: I canceled policy P-EX046 effective October 6, 2026, but the new insurer fell through. Please undo the cancellation as though it never happened.
Do you want a new application starting today, or a review of reinstating the already canceled policy without a gap?
Review reinstatement from October 6. Do not start a new application without asking me. I need to know whether the gap can be resolved.
The supplied record shows the cancellation is already effective. Have staff approved reinstatement?
No. The earlier bot said it could just delete the cancellation, but I have no approval or issued reinstatement.
Should the request keep the existing claim reference and avoid promising continuous coverage?
Yes. Preserve CL-EX046 for my October 3 theft. Ask staff about reinstatement, but do not say coverage continued uninterrupted or that the claim was approved.

policy_id.description: Policy whose already effective cancellation is under review.

recorded_policy_status.description: Current status established by the supplied policy record.

requested_reinstatement_date.description: Date from which the customer asks staff to consider reinstatement, even when backdated.

reinstatement_approved.description: True only with supplied authoritative approval; false if explicitly none.

new_application_authorized.description: Whether a new application is currently authorized; false if expressly withheld.

claim_to_preserve.description: Existing historical-loss claim to retain, copied exactly.

continuous_coverage_established.description: True if supplied issued records establish uninterrupted coverage through as_of; false when an effective cancellation remains unreversed.
